slides.label: Football average home attendance
slides.source: Source: D1.ticker FBS Attendance Trends, 2025 and 2024 pages, as carried in the benchmarking workbook.
slides.title: Big 12 football: 9 of 16 schools drew more fans per home game in 2025 than in 2024
slides.subtitle: Across the two seasons the Big 12 averaged 48,069 per game, with a median of 49,726; BYU led in 2025 at 63,789. The Power 4 average in 2025 was 60,299.

slides.label: Football percent of capacity filled
slides.source: Source: D1.ticker FBS Attendance Trends, Capacity % column of the 2025 and 2024 pages. D1.ticker does not publish the capacity it divides by.
slides.title: Big 12 football stadiums were 95% full on average across 2025 and 2024, with a median of 97%
slides.subtitle: 9 of 16 Big 12 schools filled at least 95% of capacity in 2025; Kansas St filled the largest share at 104%. The Power 4 average in 2025 was 93%.

slides.label: Men's basketball average home attendance
slides.source: Source: NCAA Men's Basketball Attendance Records book, 2026 Attendance Summary (home games, 2025-26). The book does not list 2024-25 for every school, so one season is shown.
slides.title: Big 12 men's basketball averaged 9,812 fans per home game in 2025-26, with a median of 7,839
slides.subtitle: BYU led at 18,073 and TCU drew the fewest at 5,321. The Power 4 average was 10,040.

slides.label: Men's basketball percent of capacity filled
slides.source: Source: average home attendance (NCAA Attendance Records book, 2025-26) divided by arena capacity, as calculated in the benchmarking workbook.
slides.title: Big 12 men's basketball arenas were 79% full on average in 2025-26, with a median of 81%
slides.subtitle: Houston filled the largest share at 101% and Oklahoma St the smallest at 43%. The Power 4 average was 76%.

slides.label: Total operating expenses
slides.source: Source: NCAA Membership Financial Reporting System (MFRS) reports for fiscal 2025, as compiled by Sportico or posted by the school, in the benchmarking workbook. Shown: the 13 Big 12 schools that file the NCAA report and are on fiscal 2025; not shown: Baylor, BYU, TCU. The Power 4 figure covers 49 schools on the same basis.
slides.title: Big 12 departments spent $132.9M on average in fiscal 2025, with a median of $135.6M
slides.subtitle: Arizona St spent the most at $164.7M and Houston the least at $98.9M. The Power 4 average is $185.5M.

slides.label: Operating surplus (deficit)
slides.source: Source: NCAA Membership Financial Reporting System (MFRS) reports for fiscal 2025, as compiled by Sportico or posted by the school, in the benchmarking workbook. Operating revenue less operating expenses. Shown: the 13 Big 12 schools that file the NCAA report and are on fiscal 2025; not shown: Baylor, BYU, TCU. The Power 4 figure covers 49 schools on the same basis.
slides.title: 5 of 13 Big 12 departments spent more than they took in in fiscal 2025
slides.subtitle: Kansas St had the largest surplus at $12.6M and Houston the largest deficit at -$6.1M; the Big 12 median is $0.2M. The Power 4 average is -$0.6M.

slides.label: Total coaching salaries and benefits
slides.source: Source: NCAA Membership Financial Reporting System (MFRS) reports for fiscal 2025, as compiled by Sportico or posted by the school, in the benchmarking workbook. Line 22: salaries, benefits and bonuses for all coaches, paid by the university and related entities. Shown: the 13 Big 12 schools that file the NCAA report and are on fiscal 2025; not shown: Baylor, BYU, TCU. The Power 4 figure covers 49 schools on the same basis.
slides.title: Big 12 departments pay coaches $24.9M a year on average, with a median of $23.0M
slides.subtitle: Arizona St is highest at $33.1M and Cincinnati lowest at $18.7M; coaching pay is 19% of the average Big 12 budget. The Power 4 average is $33.9M.
